title: Demo enablement rollout: training + certification + publishing final demo artifacts
creator: Talia Benson
content:
## Goal
Roll out the standardized Redwood sales demo (demo tenant + deck + talk track + backup mode) to all AEs/SEs with:
1) scheduled live training sessions,
2) a repeatable certification process, and
3) a single published source of truth for the final artifacts.

This ticket is the “enablement wrapper” that turns the demo assets into something the field can reliably execute (and keeps it from drifting).

## Success criteria (exit)
- Training delivered for NA + EMEA (recorded) and attendance tracked.
- Certification rubric published; at least the pilot group (Avery/Priyom/Hannah + SE team) certified.
- Final artifacts published in the canonical locations and linked from a single index page.
- Feedback loop in place (where to file issues, who triages, SLA for demo-blockers).
- Field comms sent: “switch-over date” when old deck/demo path is deprecated.

## Scope
### In scope
- Training sessions (agenda, instructor notes, recording, Q&A capture)
- Certification rubric (pass/fail criteria; what must be live vs can be backup mode)
- Final artifact publishing + index page
- Feedback intake + triage process (Slack channel + bug tracker pointer)

### Out of scope
- Building demo tenant / automation itself (tracked in ENG tickets)
- Any customer-facing enablement content

## Primary stakeholders / approvers
- Sales exec sponsors: Stephanie Nguyen (NA), Lukas Meyer (EMEA)
- Demo technical owner: Markus Klein
- PMM: Soojin Lee (talk track + messaging)
- DevEx: Alex Martinez / Renee Sullivan (demo app + SDK snippets)
- SRE: Sean Gallagher (demo SLOs + escalation)

Approvals needed before “GA rollout” comms:
- Markus: technical readiness + runbook is usable
- Soojin: deck + talk track language is final
- Sean: escalation path + demo Sev2 definition is live

## Deliverables
1) **Training deck + run-of-show**
   - Target: 60 minutes live + 15 minutes Q&A
   - Split: (a) story + narrative, (b) live steps, (c) objection paths + backup mode

2) **Certification**
   - Required for: all SEs who run demos; optional (recommended) for AEs
   - Format: 1 recorded run-through + 1 live checkout with a certified reviewer
   - Artifacts required: completed checklist + link to recording + “known-good scenario” verification

3) **Published artifact index (single source of truth)**
   - Links to:
     - Confluence: demo deck v1 (canonical)
     - Confluence: demo talk track script v1
     - Confluence: demo personas/scenarios
     - Confluence: competitive objections cheat sheet
     - Confluence: security FAQ links/answers
     - Runbooks: reset + capacity/quotas + demo SLO doc
     - Drive: demo scenario checklist + failure modes/backup plan

## Proposed training agenda (v1)
0. (5m) What we’re demoing + why it’s standardized (consistency + resilience)
1. (8m) Discovery questions to pick the right demo path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private narrative)
2. (20m) Live demo: Core API (streaming, structured output, tool calling, retries)
3. (10m) Live demo: Production economics (batching/caching toggles + token-level breakdown)
4. (7m) Live demo: Reliability (fallback routing + graceful degradation)
5. (5m) Console tour: observability + rollouts view (what to click; what not to click)
6. (5m) Enterprise module (mostly narrative): SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logs, retention, VPC/Private architecture
7. (5m) Backup mode: what to do when dashboards are empty / quotas / auth breaks
8. (5m) Q&A and next steps

## Certification rubric (draft)
### Pass criteria (must demonstrate)
- Can run tenant healthcheck and explain the output (quota/model availability/dashboard ingestion)
- Can execute the 30-minute run-of-show with correct timing and clean transitions
- Can handle at least two objection paths without derailing:
  - pricing confusion (usage vs commits)
  - “why not just self-host vLLM?” (build vs buy)
  - private deployment concerns (controls + architecture)
- Can switch to backup mode (screenshots/recording) within 60 seconds when:
  - dashboards are empty
  - streaming disconnects
  - 429 throttling

### Fail criteria (auto-fail)
- Uses non-demo tenant or real customer data
- Shares credentials in chat/email or breaks least-privilege rules
- Claims specific benchmark numbers not on the approved “safe to share” list

## Comms plan
- Draft announcement to #sales + #sales-engineering:
  - where to find artifacts
  - how to request access / keys
  - training dates
  - switch-over date
- Follow-up reminder 48 hours before switch-over.

## Open questions
- Who is the long-term “certification reviewer” pool (rotation among SE leads?)
- Do we require certification for AEs who run the demo solo (no SE)?
- EMEA-specific version: do we run a dedicated EMEA session with data residency + Private emphasis?

## Links (source of truth)
- Confluence deck: sources/confluence/sales-enablement/pitch-decks/redwood-demo-deck-v1.json
- Confluence talk track: sources/confluence/sales-enablement/positioning-and-messaging/demo-talk-track-script-v1.json
- Run-of-show doc: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/demo-script-run-of-show.json
- Training agenda + certification (Drive): sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/demo-training-agenda-and-certification.json
- Failure modes + backup plan: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/go-to-market/demo-failure-modes-and-backup-plan.json
- Demo reset runbook: sources/confluence/eng-platform/runbooks/demo-tenant-reset-runbook.json
- Demo SLOs: sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/demo-environment-slos.json

## Execution plan / tasks
- [ ] Finalize training dates (NA + EMEA) w/ Stephanie + Lukas + Markus
- [ ] Finalize certification rubric and reviewer assignments
- [ ] Ensure “artifact index page” exists and points to canonical versions
- [ ] Run pilot certification (Avery, Priyom, Hannah + 2 SEs)
- [ ] Run NA training + publish recording + Q&A notes
- [ ] Run EMEA training + publish recording + Q&A notes
- [ ] Announce switch-over date + deprecate old deck links

## Notes on quality / stability
We should not certify anyone until demo tenant healthcheck is reliable and reset is consistently under ~10 minutes. If we can’t guarantee that, we need to explicitly train on backup mode and make it first-class (not “panic”).
comments: 2025-11-20 (Talia Benson): Created issue after Stephanie/Lukas thread. We have demo tenant work moving; need enablement to land in parallel so we don’t end up with ‘great demo, only Markus can run it.’

2025-12-03 (Soojin Lee): PMM request: training must include approved phrasing for “production economics” + which benchmark charts are safe to share. Please add a hard rule in the certification rubric (auto-fail if off-list numbers are claimed).

2026-01-09 (Markus Klein): SE feedback: require a ‘healthcheck first’ step in the run-of-show. People keep starting with Console and getting empty dashboards. Suggest: 2-minute preflight + if failing, jump to backup screenshots immediately.

2026-01-22 (Sean Gallagher): From SE feedback session: make escalation explicit. Define demo Sev2 and put the alias in the artifact index. Also: remind folks not to “fix” quota/capacity ad hoc during a live customer call without logging it (we need traceability).

2026-02-04 (Elliot Price): Drafted the training agenda and certification checklist. Waiting on final deck visual refresh (DES-618) and annotated Console screenshots (DES-611) before scheduling the broad rollout.

2026-02-14 (Elliot Price): Proposed dates sent to Stephanie/Lukas for week-of 02/17. Next: publish single index page in Confluence and lock down canonical links (too many Drive copies floating around).
